page.overview:
Who is Reuven?

Reuven was the king of Esperia seventy years ago. He was the husband of Queen Candelle and the adoptive father of Princess Shuri, who killed him 62 years ago after both were turned into demons.

At age 30, Reuven was a larger man with an overall stern, scruffy appearance. He had a frazzled haircut, a pronounced jaw with a stubble, and large lips. He wore a simple tank top alongside striped pants, held up by a large belt, with a pearl necklace, a royal coat with a chain wrapped around it, and a small crown. By age 38, he appeared more dirtied as a result of Esperia's hardships.

At age 21, Reuven already had an old-looking face, but was much slimmer and lacked facial hair. He had no crown and typically wore a dark military uniform-like attire. When hiding his royal status, he wore much plainer clothes.

Befitting his stern appearance, Reuven was a serious individual, to a comical degree. For example, he took Brook's feelings toward his wife Candelle as intentions of an assassination plot, and tried to attack the former when he rejected marrying his young daughter instead. However, he was willing to put this part of himself aside out of concern for his family. He was willing to tolerate Brook's casual attitude due to his role as a powerful royal guard, relying on him when he believed his wife to be in danger.
